title: QA run · area:studio-authoring (17/17) · 2034975a · 2026-10-16 · 16 PASS / 1 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN
body:
Slice `area:studio-authoring` of the #23878 wave (the full platform-checklist run on main). A cloud runner ran it for the #23878 runner session `session_01K3qUoyh1xFGoWzAACPMbXJ`. The maintainer, verbatim: 「测试资源不够，你可以开云卡片吧？」 · 「测试遇到的问题，随时使用 pm-dispatch 技能提交issue」 · 「我不是马上要发布，就是测试看还有什么新问题，一起都要解决」.

Text only. Screenshots were consulted live as oracles and are not attached. The durable truth stays in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json`.

## Environment fingerprint

- **Framework (subject):** objectstack `2034975a47193f04db4791614f4ac9331ff211d3` (main, detached), `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build`: 75/75 turbo tasks, 9 min.
- **Console:** objectui **`daeb77fc84dd`** (`.objectui-sha`), **built against spec `a35f7a67^`** (`34b740f`).
  - Built in a linked worktree with `scripts/build-console.sh`, because `pnpm objectui:build` fails on main (#23908, not re-filed): the pin imports `checkPageComponentViewData`, which #23784 deleted from spec.
  - The resulting `packages/console/dist` was copied into a second linked worktree at the subject sha, alongside every framework `dist` built from the subject tree. There, `pnpm check:console-sha` reports "Console dist matches the objectui pin (objectui@daeb77fc84dd)".
  - **Every browser verdict below ran on objectui daeb77fc built against spec `a35f7a67^`.** Framework code is the subject's.
- **App / boots:** `examples/app-showcase` from that worktree, `OS_PORT=P objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p P -d file:DIR/data.db`.
  - Ports: 4310 (parent API legs), 4320 / 4330 / 4340 (browser lanes A / B / C), 4350 (the picklist fixture boot) and 4360 (re-verification of the extracted observations). Each boot had its own DB.
  - The 4340 lane ran a second boot with `OS_PAGE_REACT=off`, confirmed through `/proc/PID/environ`.
  - The picklist fixture ran from a third scratch worktree at the subject sha. Its `examples/app-showcase/objectstack.config.ts` edit (a `definePicklist` plus one `picklistExtensions` entry) was uncommitted and reverted, and that boot used `--compile`.
- **Admin:** `admin@objectos.ai` from `--seed-admin`. Members were minted with `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/create-user`, and identity was proven with `GET /auth/get-session` before each persona cell.
- **Browser:** Playwright from Node on `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`. Each persona had its own context with a form sign-in.
- **Execution:**
  - Three runner subagents (lanes A, B, C) ran in parallel, each on its own port and DB. The parent ran the API legs, the picklist item, the Tier-1 pins and the re-verification.
  - The lanes ran 12:47–13:19Z on 2026-10-16. No server stayed up during any vitest run.
- **Tier-1 pins cited (this repo, `--maxWorkers=1`):**
  - `packages/objectql/src/overlay-precedence.test.ts`: 26/26.
  - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.diagnostics-store-outage.test.ts` + `metadata-diagnostics.union-issues.test.ts`: 2 files, 25/25.
  - `packages/qa/dogfood/test/dashboard-designer-roundtrip.dogfood.test.ts`: 3/3.
- **objectui pins (RUNNER option b):** run inside the objectui checkout at **daeb77fc** that `build-console.sh` cloned: `celAuthoring.test.ts`, `CelPredicateField.test.tsx`, `CelTestRunDialog.test.tsx`, `PermissionAdvancedFacets.cel.test.tsx`, `PermissionMatrixEditor.fieldBulk.test.tsx` and `PermissionMatrixEditor.readonly.test.tsx`. Result: 6 files, 81/81. The run includes `describe('celAuthoring · graceful degradation')`.
- **Server-restart evidence:** every boot that scored a no-restart clause shows exactly one "Development Mode … ✓ Server is ready" sequence, and the listening PID did not change across the sequence (lane A PID 17092, lane B PID 16830).

## Per-clause verdicts (text evidence)

Clause ids are `cN`, the index in the item's `acceptance`.

### studio-authoring.first-run-loop · rev 3 · PASS (lane A, :4320, one boot)
- c0 PASS: Home → Build an app → Studio "New package (writable base)" wizard: 维修中心 / `com.example.repairs` / namespace `repairs` → `POST /api/v1/packages` 201. The switcher lists "维修中心 com.example.repairs Writable".
  - No-reload proof: a second package created from the switcher appeared in the same document, and a `window` marker survived.
- c1 PASS: New object "Repair Ticket" auto-suggested `repair_ticket` and was saved as `repairs_repair_ticket`. OWD was pre-selected "Private — owner only".
  - Status picklist (open / in_progress / done) → autosave PUT 200 → Publish all → `POST /packages/com.example.repairs/publish-drafts` 200, toast "Published 1 item in this package (one atomic release)".
  - `GET /meta/object/repairs_repair_ticket` → `fields.status` with exactly 3 options.
- c2 PASS: Studio Records grid → Add record "Broken compressor", Status "In Progress" → `POST /data/repairs_repair_ticket` 201. `GET /data/repairs_repair_ticket` → `status:'in_progress'`.
- c3 PASS: Create app "Repair Center" → `repair_center`, nav seeded (checkbox default ON, knownGap) → Publish all 200.
  - Home launcher shows the Repair Center tile.
  - The end-user list `/apps/com.example.repairs/repairs_repair_ticket` shows the row with a blue "In Progress" label chip.
  - `GET /meta/app?id=repair_center` navigation is `[{type:'object', objectName:'repairs_repair_ticket'}]`.
- c4 PASS: the boot log has one "Development Mode … Server is ready" sequence. Listener PID 17092 (12:47:40) was unchanged through the end-user list, and no code was written.
- c5 PASS: forged writes to the read-only showcase:
  - `PUT /meta/object/showcase_qa_forged?mode=draft&package=com.example.showcase` → 422 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`.
  - `PUT /meta/object/showcase_task?mode=draft&package=com.example.showcase` (+field) → 403 `ITEM_LOCKED`.
  - The same without `?package` → 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`.
  - Afterwards `showcase_qa_forged` is 404, and `showcase_task` has no added field.

- c2 PASS: `repair_asset` typed key by key into `object-name-input` reads back `repair_asset` (underscore kept). A screenshot confirmed render first.
- c3 PASS: the select-needs-options banner showed before any real option (expected). With 3 real options plus 1 empty row, there was no `validation-banner` / `role=alert` / "at least 2 characters" after a 3.5 s debounce. The saved PUT and the published meta both carry exactly 3 options.

### studio-authoring.draft-publish-lifecycle · rev 5 · PASS (parent :4310 API legs; lane B :4330 browser legs)
- c0 PASS: `PUT /meta/dashboard/qa_lifecycle_probe?mode=draft` (bar widget on `showcase_task_metrics`, `[status]` / `[task_count]`) → 200 `{success, version, seq 9, state:'draft'}`. GET → 404.
- c1 PASS: `POST …/publish` 200 seq 10. GET 200 serves widget "Rev1 by status".
- c2 PASS: draft rev2 ("Rev2 by priority", `[priority]`) is staged while the live read stays on rev1. After publish the live read is rev2.
- c3 PASS: PUT with If-Match = the rev1 version → 409 `METADATA_CONFLICT` with `currentVersion`. The audit row reads `outcome denied`, `code metadata_conflict`.
- c4 PASS: writable `com.qa.lcpkg` (namespace `qalc`).
  - Drafts `qalc_good` + `bad_noprefix` → `POST /packages/com.qa.lcpkg/publish-drafts` → HTTP 200, body `data.success:false`, `outcome:'refused'`, `failed[0].code NAMESPACE_PREFIX`. Both names are still 404 (atomic).
  - After discarding the bad draft and staging `qalc_second` → `data.success:true`, `publishedCount 2`, both 200.
  - The 200-with-success:false shape is the open ledger question (#7753 item 2) and is not scored.
- c5 PASS: a widget carrying a stray `object` key is refused already at the draft door: 422 `INVALID_METADATA` `widgets.0 [unrecognized_keys]`. Publish then answers 404 `NO_DRAFT`, and the GET is 404, so nothing crosses into active.
- c6 PASS (lane B): a dashboard draft staged in writable `com.qa.laneb` shows the "Unpublished draft" chip and a "1" pill on the Changes button in Studio. Publish all → publish-drafts 200 → chip and pill gone, also after a reload.
- c7 PASS: `/history` → v1 create (draft), v2 publish, v3 create, v4 publish, ascending seq 9–12, actor = the admin id.
- c8 PASS: `/diff?from=2&to=4` → `added [] removed [] changed [{path:'widgets', from:[…Rev1/status…], to:[…Rev2/priority…]}]`. It names `widgets` only, with no label or columns dump.
- c9 PASS: `POST …/rollback {toVersion:1}` → 200 `restoredFromVersion 1`, and GET serves "Rev1 by status".
  - Lane B, own boot, the same sequence: the rendered `/apps/showcase_app/dashboard/qa_lifecycle_probe` shows the bar "Rev1 by status" with status buckets.
  - `{}` and `{toVersion:'abc'}` → 400 `INVALID_REQUEST` "'toVersion' (positive integer) is required".
- c10 PASS: the `/audit` rows for save, publish, rollback and the denied conflict each carry `actor` = the admin user id.
- c11 PASS: rollback with header `X-Actor: someone_else_entirely` → 200. Its audit row names the admin id, and `someone_else` is absent from both `/audit` and `/history`.

### studio-authoring.expression-editors · rev 3 · PASS (lane B; engine truth = a direct import of `@objectstack/formula` 18.0.0-next.2 with celAuthoring's own arguments)
- c0 PASS: formula editor `record.est_hours * 1.1` → "Σ Result type: Number". `record.a + record.b` → "Result type: Unknown — … Wrap operands in double() / int() / string()". The engine infers number / unknown.
- c1 PASS: the edited formula `string(record.est_hours)` → saved `returnType:"text"`. The un-edited sibling `sib_total` keeps its prior `returnType:"number"` (formulaEdited guard).
- c2 PASS: lint tiers equal the engine for every probe:
  - `est_hourz` → error unknown-field;
  - bare `est_hours` → error bare-reference, and autosave is held;
  - `record.est_hours *` → error invalid-cel;
  - non-pushdownable USING → warning, matching engine `isPushdownableCel ok:false`.
- c3 PASS: `previous.` / `record.` open a listbox with this object's fields, and Enter inserts. `current_user.` offers none of them. A bare `est_hours` is withheld from completion and flagged.
- c4 PASS: RLS USING, non-pushdownable → amber widen-access warning with Save enabled. Parse fault `owner_id == ` → red error, Save disabled, title "Fix the CEL syntax errors before saving."
  - The persisted policy reads back in `GET /meta/permission/qab_matrix` `rowLevelSecurity`.
- c5 PASS: Test-policy dialog results:
  - `status == 'open'` with an open sample → Allowed;
  - the same predicate with a closed sample → Denied;
  - `est_hours * 2` → "Non-boolean result 6".
  - Engine evaluate gives true / false / 6.
- c6 PASS: in the parity table, every editor verdict equals the engine verdict.
- c7 PASS (pin, RUNNER option b): objectui `celAuthoring.test.ts` "celAuthoring · graceful degradation" (lint [], introspect fallback, test-run 'unavailable'), at objectui **daeb77fc**, within the 81/81 run.
